Shrouded in Mist#000.src: Group up with the remaining members at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#005.src: About what? What could you possibly be thinking about right-
Shrouded in Mist#005.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#006.src: I don't know, Yusanu! Maybe about what to do next? How we can- h-how we-
Shrouded in Mist#006.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#007.src: There's nothing we can do! We're stuck in unfamiliar territory, all lone, our family and friends all captured, or- or worse-
Shrouded in Mist#007.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#009.src: Urgh! I can't believe I let her convince me stealing this... this thing was worth it! If I hadn't, then... then our agreement wouldn't have fallen through, and none of this would have-
Shrouded in Mist#009.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#010.src: Don't you dare pin this on Rex. You heard what that Sovereign said, they- th-they knew what we were planning for ages!
Shrouded in Mist#010.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#011.src: ...then maybe it'd have been best if you left us out of it.
Shrouded in Mist#011.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#016.src: Woah woah woah woah woah! Alright, let's all take a step back, shall we?

Shrouded in Mist#017.src: Owls! Step down! Bit of a leap, jumping straight to violence- we reserve that for the obviously crown-aligned, eheheh.

Shrouded in Mist#018.src: Allow me to introduce myself! The name's Rurie, member of the Canopy, captain of the Owls division! Apologies for the roughhousing, seems everyone's a little enthusiastic today, eh?
Shrouded in Mist#018.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#020.src: Questions, questions! I'm afraid it's our turn first- I've called the owls off for a time, but don't think you're off the hook just yet, young lady!
Shrouded in Mist#020.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#021.src: ...captain, are you certain about this? For all we know, they could be spies-
Shrouded in Mist#021.speaker: Owl Fighter

Shrouded in Mist#022.src: Ah ah ah! Trust in the process, my friend. Spies or not, information is valuable.
Shrouded in Mist#022.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#023.src: Besides! We know how to... ah, deal with spies, as it were. Risk factor is minimal!
Shrouded in Mist#023.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#024.src: So... what, are you also resisting-
Shrouded in Mist#024.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#025.src: Hold it there, mister! Didn't you hear me? We'll be asking the questions here first.
Shrouded in Mist#025.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#026.src: Seems you're the only one who hasn't spoken yet! Well now, don't be shy. Tell me - where are you lot from?
Shrouded in Mist#026.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#027.src: Really? Quite far afield, aren't you? Finding your way from there to here is quite an endeavor.
Shrouded in Mist#027.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#028.src: Ahhh! Now the pieces are clicking together! I think I get it now.
Shrouded in Mist#028.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#029.src: Ohoho? Really now? How very, very curious. You're either a verrrry clever spy, or...
Shrouded in Mist#029.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#030.src: H... hey! Listen! I don't know who, or, or what you guys are, but--
Shrouded in Mist#030.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#031.src: How many times must I repeat myself? I said no que-
Shrouded in Mist#031.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#032.src: Shut UP! We just BARELY escaped {p} after we- after we tried to KILL the Queen! The rest of our friends are... captured, or d- dead!
Shrouded in Mist#032.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#033.src: So- so either leave us alone, or I'll- I'll make sure you never see your loved ones a- again!
Shrouded in Mist#033.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#036.src: Ohoho, she's sure got some temper, huh?
Shrouded in Mist#036.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#037.src: Rurie... her story could explain what-
Shrouded in Mist#037.speaker: Owl Fighter

Shrouded in Mist#038.src: Yes, my friend, I was just thinking the very same thing. Well well, new folk, if what you're saying is true, the Canopy might just be able to assist!
Shrouded in Mist#038.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#039.src: I may have information regarding your allies.
Shrouded in Mist#039.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#041.src: Ah- but! But but but, see- trust is a currency here in the {p}. I can't just spill all my secrets at once, can I?
Shrouded in Mist#041.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#042.src: And if you'd like to earn our trust... I'll need you to, ah, deal with some things for me.
Shrouded in Mist#042.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#044.src: Oh, nothing too difficult... I'll tell you on one condition! I'll be taking one of you with me as leverage! Eenie, meenie, money... you, little man!
Shrouded in Mist#044.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#046.src: You, indeed! Worry not, for I'll be sure to keep you safe, but... well, you understand the need, yes?
Shrouded in Mist#046.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#047.src: We can't! We can't lose... we can't lose anyone else. Please, there has to be something-
Shrouded in Mist#047.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#048.src: Sui... it's... fine. I don't think we have a choice. Just... do what they ask of you.
Shrouded in Mist#048.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#050.src: Goodness, so melodramatic! Come on, I'm a trustworthy fella! You've got nothing to worry about from me.
Shrouded in Mist#050.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#052.src: Ah-mazing! I'm glad you chose to be reasonable. In that case - I'll need the remaining two of you to go and sabotage three military structures.
Shrouded in Mist#052.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#053.src: Now, go and say your goodbyes, then come grab the list from me!
Shrouded in Mist#053.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#054.src: Talk to Rurie before heading out at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#055.src: Hey. You'll be fine. I'll be fine.
Shrouded in Mist#055.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#056.src: I think we can trust them for now, at least. Not like we have an alternative...
Shrouded in Mist#056.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#058.src: We really... don't have a choice, do we? We, we need their support.
Shrouded in Mist#058.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#059.src: I just... hope Yusanu will be safe.
Shrouded in Mist#059.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#060.src: Ugh... Captain's being reckless as usual...
Shrouded in Mist#060.speaker: Owl Fighter

Shrouded in Mist#061.src: Have we finished with the heartfelt goodbyes? Excellent. Truly, I am glad you took me up on this generous offer.
Shrouded in Mist#061.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#062.src: Don't worry about your little friend over there! He'll be safe and sound amongst our Canopy.
Shrouded in Mist#062.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#063.src: ...and how can we trust you? To not... hurt him?
Shrouded in Mist#063.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#064.src: Ah, isn't that the issue at the heart of it all? You can't. But as I said, trust is valuable in these woods. That must go both ways!
Shrouded in Mist#064.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#065.src: Well, newbies! You've a list of the structures I need you to sabotage, so it really should be a simple task.
Shrouded in Mist#065.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#066.src: Just find a way to... disable them! However you manage it, I can't say I really care - so long as it gets done!
Shrouded in Mist#066.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#068.src: Why, because it's a golden opportunity! The work needs doing, and you need a way to prove yourselves...
Shrouded in Mist#068.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#069.src: So why not? It's less work for me to do, so I'm not complaining!
Shrouded in Mist#069.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#070.src: Newbies! That's what you are, isn't it? New to the woods, new to the world...
Shrouded in Mist#070.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#071.src: ...maybe new to Fruma, even? Ah ah, wipe that expression of shock off your face! I won't tell if you don't either.
Shrouded in Mist#071.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#073.src: Once you're done, find me back here! Just don't take too long, eh? Wouldn't want to get bored!
Shrouded in Mist#073.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#074.src: Ta ta, newbies! Good luck out there! And just a word of advice - stay on your guard. You never know what the mists may be hiding.
Shrouded in Mist#074.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#075.src: Select the structure to sabotage using the checklist.

Shrouded in Mist#076.src: Still a bit lost? Just use your taskbook to find the things I need broken!
Shrouded in Mist#076.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#077.src: Head to the watchtower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and sabotage it using a spell.

Shrouded in Mist#078.src: So is this... the place? "Military... Watchtower..." I guess so.
Shrouded in Mist#078.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#079.src: Those supports look rather unstable, don't they? I wonder...
Shrouded in Mist#079.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#080.src: C-can you deal with them, please?
Shrouded in Mist#080.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#081.src: Huh?! We're under attack - it must be the Canopy!
Shrouded in Mist#081.speaker: Watchtower Guard

Shrouded in Mist#083.src: Let's just get this over with.
Shrouded in Mist#083.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#085.src: Check the book, where should we go next?
Shrouded in Mist#085.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#087.src: Head to the water pump at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and sabotage it.

Shrouded in Mist#089.src: I think we can work together for this one. Go, um, blast some weak spots on the structure, and I'll... see if I can reverse the water flow.
Shrouded in Mist#089.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#090.src: Let's just... get rid of this hunk of junk.
Shrouded in Mist#090.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#091.src: You, um, should try to blast some of the weak points with your magic.
Shrouded in Mist#091.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#092.src: Did you manage to apply some pressure on the pipes?
Shrouded in Mist#092.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#093.src: Good, then it's... time for my part, I guess. Um, come talk to me when you're ready.
Shrouded in Mist#093.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#095.src: Okay... okay. Breathe. I need to... focus.
Shrouded in Mist#095.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#096.src: After... after, um, everything that- that's happened, I've been... struggling with my cur-... ugh. You get what I mean.
Shrouded in Mist#096.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#097.src: It all feels so... so... hopeless! We've lost everyone, and now- now we've lost Yusanu too, and I... I couldn't do anything!
Shrouded in Mist#097.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#098.src: And the last thing we did before was... argue! And now, he's... he's safe, probably, but... I don't know. I wish we hadn't.
Shrouded in Mist#098.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#099.src: Every time I think about- about any of it, I get so... angry! And the swirling ocean around me starts raging more and more and more, and... and...
Shrouded in Mist#099.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#100.src: I'm scared, Player. I'm scared for Mora... Syndra... Rex, Zeph, the whole Steel Feather- for all of them! And I... there's nothing I can do...
Shrouded in Mist#100.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#101.src: What if... what if they're all gone? And, and, and it's just us, forever...?
Shrouded in Mist#101.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#102.src: I... I know, Player, I know! I'm... I'm trying, okay?!
Shrouded in Mist#102.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#105.src: I don't know if I, ha, have any left. Everything's... moving so fast...
Shrouded in Mist#105.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#106.src: I... I never wanted any of this. I just... I just wanted to live...
Shrouded in Mist#106.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#107.src: Sigh... okay. Sui, focus. You can do this.
Shrouded in Mist#107.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#109.src: That's... I don't... how did I...
Shrouded in Mist#109.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#110.src: It... the ocean, it... stopped. I pulled at it, and it... it stopped moving, and...
Shrouded in Mist#110.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#111.src: There's... there's no time to, to think about it. It worked, so... so that's good.
Shrouded in Mist#111.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#112.src: Just... check the book, what's our next stop?
Shrouded in Mist#112.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#113.src: I... I think that was the last one. Let's go tell Rurie that it's, um, done.
Shrouded in Mist#113.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#114.src: Head to the mining drill at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#116.src: It looks... durable. Like, um, it'll be hard to just... break. We need to find another way...
Shrouded in Mist#116.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#117.src: There- there isn't any water nearby. So, so if any soldiers show up... please, can you deal with them?
Shrouded in Mist#117.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#118.src: Aha, saboteurs! You won't get away with damaging the crown's property, not on my watch!
Shrouded in Mist#118.speaker: Mistwoods Captain

Shrouded in Mist#119.src: Um... good job, Player. I didn't think about breaking the controls...
Shrouded in Mist#119.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#120.src: We should check the book, and find our next stop.
Shrouded in Mist#120.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#121.src: Was that the last one? Let's head back to Rurie and... and tell him it's done.
Shrouded in Mist#121.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#122.src: Return to Rurie at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and discuss the next step.

Shrouded in Mist#123.src: Well well! So the newbies return! Tell me, how did you find your trial?
Shrouded in Mist#123.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#124.src: We did what you asked, so... so tell us about our friends, already!
Shrouded in Mist#124.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#125.src: Ah ah ah! Not so fast! I'm afraid you're not done quite yet!
Shrouded in Mist#125.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#127.src: Deadly serious, I fear! That, dear friends, was but the first part of your task.
Shrouded in Mist#127.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#128.src: Oh, but on the contrary! I received word immediately once you had done the deed.
Shrouded in Mist#128.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#129.src: Ugh... we had an agreement! You can't just-
Shrouded in Mist#129.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#130.src: But I can. If you want our support, you'll do what we ask. If it is any consolation, this is the last I will ask of you before our deal is concluded.
Shrouded in Mist#130.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#132.src: I would ask of you to kindly... ehm, transport an {p} citizen here. Do make sure you aren't spotted by anyone else! That could cause... issues.
Shrouded in Mist#132.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#134.src: Ah! Allow me to rephrase. You need to kidnap them.
Shrouded in Mist#134.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#136.src: Yes, indeed! Kidnap them, bring them here, and we will deal with the rest.
Shrouded in Mist#136.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#137.src: You want us to just... just snatch a random citizen from their home? And, and what do you mean "deal with the rest?"
Shrouded in Mist#137.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#138.src: No questions, young lady! Not if you'd like to ensure the safety of your friend, that is.
Shrouded in Mist#138.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#140.src: You didn't even tell us who we're looking for!
Shrouded in Mist#140.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#141.src: Ahaha, apologies, my mistake! You'll be looking for the man named Nisen. Bring him here, but don't take too long!
Shrouded in Mist#141.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#142.src: Nisen. Fine. Player, let's... talk about this outside the cave.
Shrouded in Mist#142.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#143.src: Leave the cave and discuss the plan with Sui at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#145.src: This... this is just getting ridiculous.
Shrouded in Mist#145.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#146.src: We, we need to find a way to get Yusanu back, and... and get out of here.
Shrouded in Mist#146.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#147.src: I know, I know, I know! And if we start looking, they'll, they'll notice.
Shrouded in Mist#147.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#148.src: I'm... sick and tired of following that clown's orders. But you're right...
Shrouded in Mist#148.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#149.src: It's just... weird. This last task. I don't get it.
Shrouded in Mist#149.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#150.src: Even if Rurie's out of his mind... I don't see him just- just killing an innocent person. Especially if they're, um, a resistance group.
Shrouded in Mist#150.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#151.src: Ugh. I don't know. Maybe if we investigate this Nisen person, we'll... figure out Rurie's reasoning.
Shrouded in Mist#151.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#153.src: Head to {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and locate Nisen.

Shrouded in Mist#155.src: Phew. Getting up here really wasn't the easiest... the Red Fox back in Auburn really, ha, pales in comparison.
Shrouded in Mist#155.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#156.src: I've been trying to get information on Nisen, but... people don't seem to like me much.
Shrouded in Mist#156.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#157.src: Maybe you'll have some better luck?
Shrouded in Mist#157.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#172.src: ...I don't...see it. You haven't got one Er. I. I mean. Nothing. No. Definitely, uh...definitely not.
Shrouded in Mist#172.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#173.src: I can't look, I'm really not supposed to be talking to you at all, and Wait, that counts as urgh!
Shrouded in Mist#173.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#174.src: ...I'm. I. You. ...ugh, I'm no good at this.
Shrouded in Mist#174.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#175.src: ...well. ...sorry. Nisen... I. I do know. I shouldn't be telling you, but I do know. Please don't hurt me.
Shrouded in Mist#175.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#176.src: You need to take the zipline north-west. Not the one that goes upwards, though.
Shrouded in Mist#176.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#180.src: Search Nisen's house for any [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] clues regarding him.

Shrouded in Mist#181.src: Um, let's hope he's not home...
Shrouded in Mist#181.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#182.src: That's odd... the latest entry's dated from weeks ago.
Shrouded in Mist#182.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#183.src: It's like they stopped writing them abruptly...
Shrouded in Mist#183.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#186.src: Eep! That must be Nisen! We need to think of an excuse...
Shrouded in Mist#186.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#187.src: Excuse me? What are you doing in my abode?
Shrouded in Mist#187.speaker: Nisen

Shrouded in Mist#188.src: If I am not mistaken, stumbling into other people's abodes is not a custom.
Shrouded in Mist#188.speaker: Nisen

Shrouded in Mist#189.src: Oh... I- I'm so sorry! I- I- we- we thought this was the... bakery.
Shrouded in Mist#189.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#191.src: Oh. Yes, wrong building. The bakery is down at ground level.
Shrouded in Mist#191.speaker: Nisen

Shrouded in Mist#192.src: Oh! Thank you for the directions. We are... so sorry for the misunderstanding.
Shrouded in Mist#192.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#193.src: Regroup with Sui at the main square at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#195.src: That was close... I'm, um, surprised he believed us.
Shrouded in Mist#195.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#196.src: I- I panicked, okay! But it worked, didn't it?
Shrouded in Mist#196.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#197.src: He was... surprisingly chatty. That's a nice change compared to everyone else.
Shrouded in Mist#197.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#198.src: Though, um, he was a bit... odd. He didn't seem too certain about his answers...
Shrouded in Mist#198.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#199.src: I don't know. What are you thinking? Any theories?
Shrouded in Mist#199.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#200.src: I... was thinking the same thing. It'd explain the diary entries stopping abruptly...
Shrouded in Mist#200.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#201.src: Maybe... I guess he could be. I might just be jumping to conclusions.
Shrouded in Mist#201.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#202.src: Uh... let's workshop that one a little.
Shrouded in Mist#202.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#203.src: Look, I managed to snag a schedule off his bedside table.
Shrouded in Mist#203.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#204.src: Listen to this. "Deliver hunting tools from weaponsmith through southern exit at noon."
Shrouded in Mist#204.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#205.src: It's weird, right? Something's definitely off with him... but still, kidnapping him and handing him off to some... some random bird-man! I don't like it.
Shrouded in Mist#205.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#206.src: But... we don't have much of a choice. Let's camp outside the southern gate and wait...
Shrouded in Mist#206.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#209.src: Guess we'll just have to wait...
Shrouded in Mist#209.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#211.src: I... ha, I've been feeling really out of my depth, here. I've never had to do this much without... um, without their support.
Shrouded in Mist#211.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#212.src: But... you're here to help, so. Um. Thanks for- for sticking with me. I... I don't think I'd have made it this far without you.
Shrouded in Mist#212.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#216.src: Um... I think it worked, though. Can you help me?
Shrouded in Mist#216.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#218.src: That was... easier than I expected it to be.
Shrouded in Mist#218.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#219.src: I kind of just, um, landed on top of him? And... and here we are.
Shrouded in Mist#219.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#220.src: We should... probably get moving. I don't want anyone to- to see us!
Shrouded in Mist#220.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#221.src: Um! Control is... maybe not the right word. I... ha, I tried to freeze him. So... still working on it. I guess.
Shrouded in Mist#221.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#222.src: ......how are we going to move him?
Shrouded in Mist#222.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#223.src: Um! I... didn't think about that.
Shrouded in Mist#223.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#224.src: Well well, newbies! Looks like you could use a hand!
Shrouded in Mist#224.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#225.src: Aah! Wh- where did you come from?!
Shrouded in Mist#225.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#226.src: Why, from the trees, of course! I see you've managed to subdue the good mister Nisen over here, well done, well done.
Shrouded in Mist#226.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#227.src: ...we've done everything you've asked for. Now- now tell us what you know!!
Shrouded in Mist#227.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#228.src: Oh, dear, you thought you two were done? Ha! Ahahaha!
Shrouded in Mist#228.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#230.src: Kidding! Kidding, kidding- goodness, the looks on your faces! What's a little practical joke between friends, eh?
Shrouded in Mist#230.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#231.src: Fine! Fine, fine, I get it! Jeez, lady...
Shrouded in Mist#231.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#232.src: I'll cut it with the jokes... for now. Good news! You've passed the test!
Shrouded in Mist#232.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#234.src: Yes, yes, settle down, I will tell you. Give me a moment! Goodness. You're an impatient one, aren't you?
Shrouded in Mist#234.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#235.src: I'll be bringing you two to the Canopy! But, ah, one little precaution- I'll have to blindfold you till we arrive, Just a security measure!
Shrouded in Mist#235.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#236.src: Ugh... you know what, I don't even care anymore. Just... bring us to Yusanu.
Shrouded in Mist#236.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#238.src: Ugh! Fine fine fine! But hurry up.
Shrouded in Mist#238.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#239.src: Rurie, care to explain yourself? Why did you bring these outsiders here?
Shrouded in Mist#239.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#241.src: Ah, you know how it is, Fuhue! I was oh so bored on patrol this morning! You lot aren't exactly the life of the party..
Shrouded in Mist#241.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#242.src: You know Azael has clear rules on recruiting. Did you file the necessary paperwork? Because I didn't see anything on my desk regarding this.
Shrouded in Mist#242.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#243.src: The... ah, the paperwork was real? I always thought it was something you were making up for the fun of it.
Shrouded in Mist#243.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#244.src: No. We have the protocols in place for a reason, Captain Rurie. Will you find the time to review them yourself, or must I have Captain Cileon run you through them?
Shrouded in Mist#244.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#245.src: Yes, yes, I understand the importance- though, I believe Cileon shares my views on the protocols. Isn't that right, Cileon?
Shrouded in Mist#245.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#247.src: H- hey! Don't just act like, like we aren't right here!
Shrouded in Mist#247.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#248.src: Cileon! That is also against our protocols. We wouldn't want to leave a body for the crown to find, we have far simpler forms of disposal.
Shrouded in Mist#248.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#249.src: And of course, we need to torture any necessary information out of them first - I have heard this a dozen times over.
Shrouded in Mist#249.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#250.src: Ah! You were listening! Good, Captain Rurie. We'll knock some sense into you yet.
Shrouded in Mist#250.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#251.src: I did have some deerlings bring Nisen into our processing room earlier. Thank you for your service, Captain.
Shrouded in Mist#251.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#252.src: Ah, no problem! Hardly even broke a sweat!
Shrouded in Mist#252.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#253.src: Well, I'll be catching up with you later! I suppose if we're following protocols, I'll need to hand these kids off to Azael.
Shrouded in Mist#253.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#254.src: Hey hey, friends! I'm a bit thirsty, so I'll be leaving you now! Think you'll manage to find Azael yourselves?
Shrouded in Mist#254.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#255.src: Find the leader inside the Canopy at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#256.src: Hm. Rurie told you to find Azael.
Shrouded in Mist#256.speaker: Cileon

Shrouded in Mist#265.src: The schedule's always so busy... and now I have even more to deal with.
Shrouded in Mist#265.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#266.src: But I suppose I can squeeze you in for questions.
Shrouded in Mist#266.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#267.src: I am Fuhue, Team Captain of the Deer clan.
Shrouded in Mist#267.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#268.src: I also function as the overall manager of the Canopy, not just the Deer operations.
Shrouded in Mist#268.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#269.src: Master Azael can be found in his hut... it's just to the south-west of here.
Shrouded in Mist#269.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#270.src: From what I've heard, your friend is over there as well.
Shrouded in Mist#270.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#271.src: I'm afraid so. Insufferable as always...
Shrouded in Mist#271.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#272.src: But he's incredibly talented at what he does. No one else could run the Owls like he does.
Shrouded in Mist#272.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#274.src: Or not! It's Master Azael's decision as to whether you stay or not. Just hope you manage to impress him.
Shrouded in Mist#274.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#275.src: I have heard about your adventures in the {p} thus far. Very impressive work.
Shrouded in Mist#275.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#276.src: Not to interrupt you, but we've been running around all day, and I'm tired. Where's Yusanu?
Shrouded in Mist#276.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#279.src: Oh, you're okay... I'm so glad.
Shrouded in Mist#279.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#280.src: Yes, reunited at last. But now that you are here, it is time for business.
Shrouded in Mist#280.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#281.src: I had Yusanu inform me of your adventures in the {p}.
Shrouded in Mist#281.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#282.src: And it would appear our causes are in alignment... to dismantle the crown. We here in the Canopy have taken a very active approach to this end.
Shrouded in Mist#282.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#283.src: We had established three teams, each with their own responsibility. Each team attacks the crown on different fronts.
Shrouded in Mist#283.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#284.src: The Owls are our eyes and ears. They are also our most efficient assassins. Captain Rurie, who you have already had the pleasure of meeting, is one of our most lethal members.
Shrouded in Mist#284.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#285.src: The Foxes are our assault team. They are skilled swordsmen utilizing techniques native to the {p}. They are trained to never lose a duel.
Shrouded in Mist#285.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#286.src: The Deers are our command team, the brains behind the operation. They are also responsible for... taking care of spies within {p}.
Shrouded in Mist#286.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#288.src: Spies. That man you brought in, Nisen... I fear that is no longer Nisen. Weeks ago, he had been replaced by one of the crown's elite spies. We know them as Changelings.
Shrouded in Mist#288.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#289.src: The {p} have been plagued for years by these masterful creatures of disguise. Whenever one is recognized, we capture them and hold them for questioning.
Shrouded in Mist#289.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#290.src: The people of our region have developed a form of identification, the medallions. If you do not possess one, many will refuse to speak with you.
Shrouded in Mist#290.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#291.src: Um... Azael, sir, I don't mean to come off as rude, but... Rurie told us there were news on our friends from the Roughworks.
Shrouded in Mist#291.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#292.src: In a sense, there are. However, we still are processing the information the Owls have returned with from the festival. I cannot offer anything just yet.
Shrouded in Mist#292.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#293.src: Rest assured, we will not withhold anything once we have gone through everything.
Shrouded in Mist#293.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#294.src: I give you my word that we will continue searching for any word of your friends.
Shrouded in Mist#294.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#295.src: It... it finally feels like we have a second to breath.
Shrouded in Mist#295.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#296.src: I'll stay with Yusanu and wait for them to sort through the information.
Shrouded in Mist#296.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#297.src: I'm going to focus on figuring out what this device is used for.
Shrouded in Mist#297.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#298.src: It must have be worth stealing it... somehow.
Shrouded in Mist#298.speaker: Sui
